name: Nebuzaradan Nebuzar Adan
overview: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard under King Nebuchadnezzar, played a pivotal role in the Babylonian siege of Jerusalem, overseeing the captivity of the remaining inhabitants and the distribution of land to the poor left behind (Jeremiah 39:9-10). Entrusted by the king with the care of the prophet Jeremiah, Nebuzaradan ensured Jeremiah's release and protection even amid the turmoil of exile (Jeremiah 39:11; 40:1). His actions demonstrate God's sovereign control over the nations and His providential care for His prophets during times of judgment (Jeremiah 43:6; 52:12).
